title: Dice Roll Simulation
description: Calculate the number of distinct sequences of length n that can be rolled with a die, subject to constraints on consecutive identical rolls.
pseudocode:
1. dp[n][6] = number of sequences of length n ending in face i+1
2. for i from 1 to n:
3.   for face from 0 to 5:
4.     for prev_face from 0 to 5:
5.       if face != prev_face: add dp[i-1][prev_face]
6.       else: add dp[i-1][prev_face] if roll_count <= rollMax[face]

steps.note: Initialize DP table for sequence length 1 with 6 faces.
Iterating through previous faces to sum valid sequences.
Add sequences ending in different faces.
